S Marvelous
is an album by
Ray Conniff
and His Orchestra. It was released in mono in 1957 on the
Columbia
label (catalog no. CL 1074) and in stereo (catalog no. CS 8037) in 1958.
[
1
]
[
2
]
Chart performance
The album came after an unsuccessful one with a bop sound, but this one debuted on
Billboard
magazine's pop album chart on December 23, 1957, peaked at No. 10, and remained on the chart for 31 weeks.
[
3
]
On the
Cash Box
albums chart, it peaked at No. 7, staying on the chart for 15 weeks.
[
4
]
It was certified by the RIAA as a gold record.
[
3
]
Reception
AllMusic later gave the album a rating of four-and-a-half stars. Reviewer William Ruhlmann called it "a set of lively arrangements of standards featuring a wordless chorus."
